fields.description: Issue includes an editorial opposing the appointment of John Rowland as Miami chief of police and criticizing alleged political influence (“Little Tammany” and “Hawthorneism”). Other coverage includes discussion of mechanical gambling devices and enforcement, commentary on telephone rates and the Railroad Commission, a report on Miami Beach school board policy regarding married teachers, a column on Miami Beach public access to the shoreline, and community features such as Miami Life’s annual picnic/outing for children (Mayfair Theater and Musa Isle), social notes, and sports/gambling tip content (“Jockey Jimmy”).
